testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect representation branches in an empty part ✔ Given a new empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser shows an expanded Representations branch ✔ And the Model State and View branches are collapsed ✔ When the user expands the Model State branch ✔ Then a checked Primary entry appears beneath it ✔ When the user expands the View branch ✔ Then Primary, Isometric, Front, Top and Right entries appear beneath it ✔ When the user right-clicks the Primary view entry ✔ Then the entry is selected ✔ And its context menu offers Activate and Copy ✔ And Lock is unavailable ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ When the user collapses the View branch ✔ Then its entries are hidden ✔ And the checked Primary model-state entry remains visible ✔ And the part viewport remains empty
